message: You know that feeling when you realize you’ve been cooking with the same old oven mitt for a decade? 🤦‍♀️ Yeah, me too! It’s a little comedy of errors we all get into when it comes to home fire safety. I just found this great resource from the NFPA that breaks down some practical tips for making our homes safer. It’s a good reminder that being prepared doesn’t have to be overwhelming — sometimes it just means being a tad more mindful. What’s your favorite tip for keeping things safe at home?
